values.projectInstructions: AGENTS.md and any applicable project instructions
values.delegation: Use @tintinweb/pi-subagents' Agent tool with the prefixed specialist name. Pass run_in_background: false when a step must finish before the next starts. Do not request automatic worktree isolation for subsequent steps in an existing task worktree. UAT uses playwright-cli and shell HTTP tools such as curl; WebFetch has no direct built-in equivalent. Agent extensions are disabled by default, but explicitly preloaded skills remain available.
